files.name: motion-prompt-097.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Backlighting" (逆光), one of the names in "Photo looks, lighting & styles".
Motion Prompt #097

What it is: The light source sits behind the subject
What the sample shows: The sun moves from outside the frame to directly behind the person's head; a thin bright edge appears around the figure, a pale warm haze covers the frame and the side facing the camera darkens.
Spec:
- Scene 1: a head-and-shoulders figure in front of a horizon at y 150 (head centre x 270, y 78, radius 29 px, no face or hair). light is a flat amber #FFC75A shape, shadow a flat #33405A one
- Sun: radius 20 px, from outside the frame (top left, x 40, y −40) to directly behind the head (x 270, y 56), with flat rings of 2.6× and 1.7× the radius (#FFE3A3 at 35% and 60%)
- Outline: the figure is stroked with a 7 px line and then filled, leaving a 3.5 px bright edge outside it
- Figure #4D5A75 → #33405A; sky #FAF9F7 → #FFF4DC; #FFE3A3 laid over the whole frame at 22%
- Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
When to use it: For airy, glowing portraits or any image that should feel bathed in light.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/097.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/photo.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
